findings.body: When two tenants use the same resource ID, any authenticated tenant can now update the first matching row regardless of ownership because `authenticatedTenant` is discarded. The route contract explicitly permits tenant-local IDs to repeat and exposes this write operation to every authenticated tenant, so this enables cross-tenant modification; retain `TenantID == authenticatedTenant` in the lookup.
findings.title: Keep tenant scope in the update predicate
